notes.title: Android release and more balance updates
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/c80e60fe1f998cf6715d8d702e20df6ea13bc600.png

Android Release
You can now play Chess Cubed anywhere!  Cross-platform play has come to the Android platform.  Download Chess Cubed  from the Play Store.

New mode
Survival mode has been added. When this mode is selected HP will not regenerate. 

Balance updates
♞ Knight movement cost has been updated to reflect a better cost to mobility balance. This balance update supports the movement sequence pictured below at a cost of 2 energy.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/06ada93371502b4586eaa9b737e1b69356baa47b.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/00e1af36239173125e19c5107aa571d6e4632ae2.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/b4b4d22b293e42bc18f4ce9917b7b83e0c347d5f.png

Just imagine the possibilities...

notes.title: Updates!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/7fd057f6b04b7282f0377c55adf84c6b725d8a21.png

Music is now customizable in settings. You can choose the song that play for When you are Tied, Winning or Losing.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/b34af965e7f1798bf7915b0612036e3719ca7aca.png

 Contextual Highlights 
Pieces now have colored Highlights for various states of game play

Green - This piece has an available move.
Yellow - This piece is encroaching on your king.
Red - This piece is checking your king.
Blue - This piece (yours) is attacking the enemy king.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/4ad51d4851c7c230b24a887c10569625a7cc4b53.png

Finally, Night mode is now an option in the lower drawer menu. The other drawers are less 'twitchy' and the minimap stays until you close it.

Next up:
Trial Mode.(puzzles and etc)
Achievements.

Oh, and Android users will be joining you by this Friday.... yup.
See you around!

- AFG
